Players Committee card image of [[Crimson Dawn Blaster]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Use 1 Force to deploy on your warrior (free if your Crimson Dawn leader on table). May target a character or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. If destiny +1 > defense value, target hit and may not be used to satisfy attrition.” Uploaded unchanged.
